# syntropd / .github

This repository contains organization-wide workflows, shared health files, and the organization profile for **syntropd** ([https://github.com/syntropd](https://github.com/syntropd)).

## Organization Profile

The active organization profile rendered on GitHub is located at [`profile/README.md`](profile/README.md).

For the project website, manuals, and Varlink specifications, visit [https://syntropd.github.io](https://syntropd.github.io).
